author: Nintendo of America
description:
Mixtape launches for Nintendo Switch 2 on May 7, 2026!

Three friends, one night, and one last adventure, set to the soundtrack of a generation.

Unfolding through a series of fantastical narrative vignettes, it’s the greatest hits of the teenage experience, from the first kiss to the last dance.

From Beethoven & Dinosaur, developers of BAFTA award-winning game The Artful Escape, Mixtape draws inspiration from classic coming-of-age movies, bringing together nostalgic aimlessness, mischief, music, the highs and lows of adolescence, and the bittersweet feelings brought about by growth, transformation, and moving on.

Featuring iconic tracks from DEVO, Roxy Music, Lush, The Smashing Pumpkins, Iggy Pop, Siouxsie and the Banshees, Joy Division, The Cure, and many more.

#IndieWorld #Mixtape #NintendoSwitch2

Blighted is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in fall 2026!

Battle through a psychedelic Western nightmare to reclaim the memories of your people in Blighted, an exploration-driven action RPG from the creators of Guacamelee! and Nobody Saves the World.

The evil Sorcisto has consumed your village and infected the world with a deadly Blight. As the lone survivor of his rampage, you must fight through surreal, hostile environments to defeat powerful bosses and recover the memories of your people... before your own Blight overtakes you.

Play solo or with a friend via local or online multiplayer as you uncover the secrets of a corrupted world.

author: Nintendo of America
description:
My Little Puppy jumps onto Nintendo Switch digitally on May 29, 2026, and physically in June!

Bong-gu the Welsh Corgi was once an abandoned dog. Then one day, a miracle happened! Bong-gu was adopted by a scruffy man who cherished Bong-gu. From that point on, Bong-gu lived out his remaining days just like any other dog would: playing tug-of-war, running around, eating, sleeping and enjoying his newfound life. In the end, Bong-gu crossed the rainbow bridge.
 
One day in doggy heaven, Bong-gu awakened from his nap to a familiar scent. His dad! Jubilant, Bong-gu sets out to escape doggy heaven and embarks on a journey to reunite with his dad—an adventure that may hold unexpected dangers. Just as his dad once found him by some miracle, it is now Bong-gu’s turn to find his dad.
 
Will Bong-gu and his dad be reunited?
